name: double-free
title: Double free
fix_goal: Heap ownership should have one release path; after free, clear the pointer or transfer ownership explicitly.
fix_steps: Find both p101_free calls that can receive the same pointer.
Remove the second release or guard it behind pointer ownership.
Set the pointer to NULL after freeing it.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm the double-free lab is fixed.
lesson: Double free is not just cleanup noise; it is an exploitation-shaped heap ownership bug.
